items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Jack and I was the best friend of mine.

ctx.x: Ask him who played the barrel house music on the violin.

Say who played the barrel house music on the violin? With Johnny? Say who played the barrel house music on the violin? Barrel house music. Oh you mean with who? No, say who played the most barrel house music on the violin? Oh you mean a long time ago? Yeah. Let's see. Played with this with Jack. Jack and I was the best friend of mine. On the violin. On the violin. On the violin. Well a brother named Joe Reynolds. That's about the only one I know could play dead. And who did he work with? Who did he work with?…
